::: {#def-fdp}
#### False discovery proportion

For a family of tests with $V$ false positives among $R$ rejections (@def-rejection-counts),
the **false discovery proportion** (FDP) is the fraction of rejections that are false positives,
counted as 0 when there are no rejections:

$$
\text{FDP} \eqdef \frac{V}{\max(R, 1)}.
$$
:::
